# SpaceBar 2.4.0 — first public release
Native menu bar spacers and dividers, free and open source.
- Independent blank spacers and adjustable dividers you can Command-drag. - One flex spacer that can adjust a centered gap as icons change. - Experimental layout backup and restore, with named snapshots and recovery before an explicit restore. Only visible, identifiable icons can be restored; some need manual arranging. Missing or disabled icons cannot be restored. - Local settings, optional Launch at Login, and no permanent controller icon. - Background centering recovery after display, session, and wake changes. - Manual **Check for Updates…** using Sparkle’s signed-update UI. Automatic checks and downloads are off.
Download target: Apple silicon, macOS 27.0 or later. Ordinary items work without Accessibility; flex geometry and layout features need access. macOS owns placement, so crowded or changed bars may need manual adjustment. Intel support is unverified. Real overnight sleep/wake testing is still pending.
Build 25 is Developer ID signed, Apple notarized, and includes a stapled notarization ticket. Installation from a quarantined download and the manual update flow passed in an isolated macOS VM, preserving settings and item IDs. Full cross-app layout restoration has not been verified and remains Experimental.
